name: smwpatches-dragon-yoshi-coin-explanation-message-v-1
title: Dragon/Yoshi Coin Explanation Message v.1.2
description:
Applying this patch will make it so that when collecting a Dragon Coin for first time, it displays a specified message, much like the Flowers in Yoshi's Island.
More information in the included "Readme.txt".
This version no longer uses SRAM Expand, but uses one byte of FreeRAM. The option to change it is removed, as it must be the specific address it uses in order to work.
